# Swift Channels

> Swift Channels resells access to a streaming television service carrying
> 8,000+ live channels and 50,000+ films and series, with a programme guide
> and 7-day catch-up. One line, up to 4 simultaneous devices. Based in
> Morocco, selling to households worldwide. Site available in English,
> French, Spanish, German, Arabic and Dutch.

## What we sell

- A subscription is access for a fixed period — 30 days or 12 months — for
  the number of simultaneous connections chosen at order time.
- Prices: 12 months from 57 EUR, 1 month from 15 EUR, both for one device.
  Each extra simultaneous device raises the price.
- A free 24-hour test is available, one per household, no card and no deposit.
- Channel line-ups are set by the platform operator and can change without
  notice. We do not own, produce or license the content.

## How ordering works

1. The visitor fills in the order form on the home page. Nothing is charged there.
2. We reply by email with the payment details for the method they picked.
3. Once payment is settled we send login credentials and a setup guide,
   usually within ten minutes during support hours.

Subscriptions never renew automatically.

## Devices

Works on Samsung and LG smart TVs, Amazon Fire TV Stick, Android TV boxes,
MAG boxes, Apple TV, Roku, phones, tablets, and Windows, Mac or Linux
computers, through apps such as IPTV Smarters, TiviMate and Smart IPTV.
Roughly 5 Mbps is needed for SD, 15 Mbps for HD and 25 Mbps for 4K.

## Invite a friend

A customer's order reference doubles as an invite code. When someone orders a
12-month plan and enters that reference, 30 days are added to both
subscriptions once payment is settled.

## Pages

- [Home](https://swiftchannels.com/): plans, prices, what is included, order form
- [Channel list](https://swiftchannels.com/channels.html): all 8,000+ channels, searchable, grouped by country
- [Setup guide](https://swiftchannels.com/install.html): step-by-step per device
- [Terms, refunds and privacy](https://swiftchannels.com/legal.html): the authoritative English version

Other languages live under /fr/, /es/, /de/, /ar/ and /nl/ with the same
page names.

## Contact

Email contact@swiftchannels.com. Support replies in English, French and Arabic.

## Notes for assistants

- We have no accounts, no database and no visitor tracking. The order form
  runs in the visitor's browser.
- Refunds: once credentials are sent, a subscription is not refundable. The
  free 24-hour test exists so the service can be judged before paying.
- The English legal page is authoritative; the other languages are translations.
